summary: Official DeepSeek Harness runtime audit passed. The execution-time npm @latest for @deepseek-ai/dsh resolved to 0.1.1-rc.2, with dist-tags latest and next both resolving to that exact version. A separate official local runtime prefix was installed from the npm registry and its CLI reported 0.1.1-rc.2; the official web profile started successfully on port 3080. Protected official ~/.dsh state remained byte/hash identical across the update. The Crew-owned runtime/profile was not modified and remained isolated at 0.1.1-rc.2 with its Hub stopped.

tests.name: Task contract and source revision
tests.evidence: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json -> VALID TASK CONTRACT; branch test/dsh-latest-runtime-audit executed at source commit 2969760ba569b580bb20128b92e64e508285c9fc.

tests.name: Execution-time npm latest resolution
tests.evidence: npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags --json returned latest=0.1.1-rc.2 and next=0.1.1-rc.2; npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest version --json returned 0.1.1-rc.2. No @next-only version was installed.

tests.name: Official @latest runtime installation and CLI version
tests.evidence: The installed top-level official package version and CLI output were both 0.1.1-rc.2, exactly matching npm @latest. Resolved source was the npm registry package @deepseek-ai/dsh; CLI entry was the independent official local runtime prefix at node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js.

tests.name: Official web Harness after update
tests.evidence: The updated official CLI started the official ~/.dsh web profile on 127.0.0.1:3080; the web root returned HTTP 200 after restart.

tests.name: Protected official ~/.dsh persistent state
tests.evidence: The protected set of settings.yaml, .credentials.yaml, profiles/**, and sessions/** remained 78 files and 3,184,216 total bytes with aggregate SHA-256 E00D590857C56C0467EA1DC86FEC1ABC7B324DBBDF0B92A903E770CED3E3FA44 before and after. .credentials.yaml remained 208 bytes/SHA-256 819FECDCBB0F35851C6B09357281DC190F3ECFD50A9A0432D5D3A651E528F02; settings.yaml remained 1332 bytes/SHA-256 B3C608B86311C10AD631306E42918F6D860350FE16CCDB38EAF317A3526095F9. No file contents or credential values were printed, copied, migrated, or committed.

tests.name: Crew-owned runtime/profile isolation
tests.evidence: Crew remained installed only in its dedicated DSH_HOME/profile; runtime version stayed 0.1.1-rc.2, runtime package SHA-256 stayed DC930C0B18158F49AE3753CEAF6B1B7AE71DC6C8F45C85A2D679B142024ADDF7, and Crew profile package SHA-256 stayed 11149ED3D0258A109CBFCD6498649851BF48B771CED3579429ADBEC70456EB14. Hub 3210 was not running, so no Crew process or configuration was changed by the audit.

tests.name: Bounded release-audit metadata
tests.evidence: npm @latest metadata reported 62 direct dependencies, peerDependencies=null, and canonical dependency-object SHA-256 019BB6D884CA80F5EDA76DE51F4F98668CACCC8809D7E553616ABC17236A376E. Compatibility-relevant direct ranges included @deepseek-ai/cordis=^4.0.1, @deepseek-ai/dsh-base=^0.1.1-rc.2, and @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app=^0.1.1-rc.2. The repository's existing dsh-crew peer/dev constraints remain 0.1.0-rc.6 for the DSH agent family and ^0.1.0-rc.5 for the SDK pair; no release-prep changes were made in this TEST_ONLY audit.

notes: Official runtime was installed in a separate non-Crew local runtime prefix from the npm registry; persistent official ~/.dsh state was not used as an install target and remained unchanged.

The first standard npm install attempt was bounded and terminated after prolonged ideal-tree computation before a completed prefix appeared; the exact same npm registry @latest package was then installed successfully with the machine's pnpm/Node toolchain in the independent official runtime prefix. No ~/.dsh or Crew state was changed by the aborted attempt.
The official web process was left running healthy on port 3080. Crew remains installed in isolated state but its Hub is stopped; no Crew runtime/profile upgrade or reconfiguration was performed.
Result Contract and deletion of docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json are the only authorized repository changes for completion.
